interpretation.claim_boundary: This scaffold uses floating marching-squares estimates for perturbed lengths and is not an interval certificate.
interpretation.next_step: If n=10 shows stable positive deficit and a coherent scaling class, repeat for n=11-14, then interval-harden the first case whose structure is representative.
interpretation.primary: If shape slopes are near 2, a smooth tensor/Hessian shape cone may be viable. If slopes are well below 2, the local proof must be stratified rather than an ordinary tensor Hessian.

method.basis: quotient root tangent basis: translation projected out, rotation omitted, singular radial retained
method.shape_cone_probe: all quotient directions except singular radial m0
method.unit_disk_flags: diagnostic only; the EHP monic-polynomial problem does not impose a roots-in-unit-disk constraint
